# function: arc_zonal_shift_nlb

Builds the ARN for `arc-zonal-shift` `NLB`:

```
arn:${Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${Region}:${Account}:loadbalancer/net/${LoadBalancerName}/${LoadBalancerId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:loadbalancer/net/load-balancer-name/load-balancer-id
output "arc_zonal_shift_nlb" {
  value = provider::arn::arc_zonal_shift_nlb("load-balancer-name", "load-balancer-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
arc_zonal_shift_nlb(load_balancer_name string, load_balancer_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `load_balancer_name` (String) Value for `${LoadBalancerName}` in the ARN template.
1. `load_balancer_id` (String) Value for `${LoadBalancerId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
